name: Ameiro no Kisetsu
source:
Hokkaido. Main character lives with two older sisters Yuuko and Kasumi. He learns that he is not blood related with his relatives. Siblings have feelings for each other, but keep it secret. But one day hero's father returns from overseas trip with a new family...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在北海道。主人公与两位姐姐八神优子和八神霞共同生活。一天，他得知自己与家人之间并无血缘关系。姐弟彼此怀有感情，却都把心意藏在心底。然而某天，父亲从海外归来，还带回了一个新的家庭……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
